area_definition: effective development envelope, zero buffer, not foundation footprint

economic_parameters.source: NREL/PR-5000-88335, 2022 Cost of Wind Energy Review (2023), pp. 25, 27, 29, 30
economic_parameters.reference_layout_rule: Deterministic farthest-point selection on a 1.01*d_min grid inside the original XML allowed region; independent of candidate count M and algorithms
economic_parameters.substation_rule: Fixed at (Width/2, 0); scenario assumption, not supplied by WindFLO
economic_parameters.parameter_transfer_status: Research benchmark transfer from a 3.3 MW US land-based reference to WindFLO's 1.5 MW turbine, not site-calibrated pricing
explicit_assumptions: Electrical infrastructure budget is scaled linearly by rooted geometric connection length; this scaling is our approximation, not the NREL cost model
The electrical budget is subtracted from total CAPEX before adding the layout-scaled term, avoiding double counting
FCR is used directly; do not multiply by CRF again
Reference financing assumes 25 years; reference source has taxes/depreciation, but these are not separately simulated here
No additional nonwake losses are asserted; AEP already includes the modeled wake loss
No electrical capacity, loss, voltage-drop, road-routing or terrain-engineering feasibility claim

wake_scope: Area-weighted rotor overlap Jensen, per-source mean deficit then RSS; fixed CT; not pointwise rotor quadrature or terrain flow

terrain.source: synthetic analytic terrain sampled on a regular DEM; not observed data
terrain.coordinate_system: local Cartesian metres, no real geographic location or EPSG
terrain.formula: 100 + A*sin(2*pi*x/7000)*sin(2*pi*y/14000) + B*exp(-0.5*((u/600)^2+(v/2500)^2)); u,v are 25-degree rotated offsets from (3800,7600)
terrain.slope_limit_status: declared scenario assumption, not an engineering code or site approval threshold
terrain.slope_rule: A cell is excluded if the maximum gradient magnitude of its bilinear DEM surface exceeds tan(limit).

wind_height_assumption: WindFLO distributions imposed uniformly at turbine hubs; measured reference height is not supplied
connection_scope: MST of DEM-surface lengths along straight horizontal routes; no routing or electrical feasibility claim
cost_anchor: Same flat reference length as V4; not recalibrated to cancel terrain-induced length changes
timing_scope: Wall components can overlap (kernel setup inside energy); never sum them as disjoint pure CPU time
evaluation_backend: v7 exact dense Prim; same complete graph and cost function
search_surrogate: Frequency-weighted squared wake kernel guides proposals only; exact objectives determine selection
